protocol.description: Synthetic growth dataset v1: 60 distinct initial concentrations spanning 1.25-1.45, six verified paired recipes per group, 360 episodes and 1080 exact-horizon samples. Twelve concentration strata each assign 3 train / 1 validation / 1 test groups, with deterministic split seed 20261110; both range endpoints are training anchors. Fixed verified 32^3 focused grid, dt=1, duration=30 and sampling depth=0.75. Illustrative model units and kinetics; quality unavailable; no ML fitting.
